verdict.rationale: INPI runs online filing services and an API-backed IP data portal, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test or staging environment. The only API-related item is a probe showing data.inpi.fr returns 403 to keyless requests, which says nothing about isolated testing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
